runtime_reference_facts.runtime_pairlist_line: updated every 10 steps, buffer 0.011 nm, rlist 0.911 nm

paths.physical_role: Initializes Coulomb PME reciprocal-space work and independently toggles LJ-PME.
why: TP1.7b-safe log says 'Will do PME sum in reciprocal space for electrostatic interactions.'
Source sets pme->doCoulomb = usingPme(ir->coulombtype) and pme->doLJ = usingLJPme(ir->vdwtype).

paths.physical_role: Chooses the short-range Coulomb direct-space kernel family.
why: For PME or Ewald electrostatics, the short-range direct-space kernel stays in the Ewald/EwaldTwin family rather than ReactionField.
This means TP1.8 can change the reciprocal solver while keeping the short-range Coulomb family fixed.

paths.physical_role: Chooses the short-range VdW kernel family.
why: Safe authoritative mdout uses vdw-type = Cut-off, so the Cut-off VdW kernel is selected.
This excludes LJ-PME reciprocal correction from the active authoritative path.

paths.physical_role: Prepares the LJ-PME grid combination rule only when vdw-type = Pme.
why: Source only enters LJ-PME combination-rule logic when forcerec.ic->vdw.type == VanDerWaalsType::Pme.
Safe authoritative mdout uses vdw-type = Cut-off.

paths.physical_role: Builds LJ-PME dispersion-grid parameters for the PCFF 9-6 path only when LJ-PME is active.
why: The PCFF 9-6 LJ-PME grid branch is guarded by usingLJPme.
Safe authoritative mdout uses vdw-type = Cut-off, so this TP1.4-style reciprocal LJ path is inactive here.

paths.physical_role: Disables SIMD kernels for repulsion power 9 and keeps the plain-C reference short-range kernels active.
why: Safe authoritative log reports repulsion power 9 and plain-C kernels.
This is a short-range family fact, not evidence that LJ-PME reciprocal correction is active.
